item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the subtropical ridge extending westwards and covering southern China during the weekend and next week, the weather will be mainly fine and remain very hot over the region. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 16/07 (Saturday)
Wind: Southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine apart from isolated showers. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 29 - 34 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
